name: berth-plugin-github
description: GitHub's CLI and sign-in for berth machines.

features.label: GitHub CLI
features.description: GitHub's command line tool, gh, and git set up to use its login for github.com. Adds its sign-in to the overview. A GH_TOKEN secret given to the host works without signing in.
features.summary: GitHub CLI (`gh`). `gh auth status` tells whether it is signed in; git uses that login for github.com.

actions.name: status
actions.label: GitHub sign-in
actions.help: Whether gh is signed in for the agent account, and as whom. Part of "Show who is signed in".
actions.run: echo '── GitHub'; gh auth status 2>&1 | grep -vi 'token:'; echo

actions.name: login
actions.label: Sign in to GitHub
actions.help: Runs gh auth login on the host as the agent, without a token. It shows a one-time code and the address github.com/login/device: open it in your own browser and enter the code. git then uses that login for github.com over HTTPS. A GH_TOKEN secret given to this host takes precedence over it.
actions.run: env -u DISPLAY -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY BROWSER=echo gh auth login --hostname github.com --git-protocol https --web && gh auth setup-git; echo; gh auth status
